_note: Interior sets for the previs, read by art/previs/render.py (a shot's "set") and explorer.html. `at`: where the set's origin (the centre of its floor) sits in explorer coords [x, y, z]; `carve`: the radius (m) round it within which the island model's own building is cut away, from `carve_above` m over the floor up. Build a set with blender -b -P art/sets/<name>.py; the GLBs are local only. A set with `bake` is also joined into its island model by art/sets/bake_paxos.py, which flattens the `bake` site (a `footprint` of explorer [x, z] corners, which it paves, or a `circle` round the set, which brings its own paving) to the `pad` height.
